what: Architectural Step 3b cleanup only clears architecture-diagram.skipped, leaving a stale architecture-diagram.md on generation or sanitizer failure
scenario_or_breakage: A Gate C loop can generate architecture-diagram.md for an earlier plan, then re-enter Step 3b after plan changes; if the new architectural diagram fails, Step 5c design-publish.sh will still publish the old non-empty diagram file
suggested_fix: Add a minimal architectural-path entry cleanup that removes architecture-diagram.md and architecture-diagram.candidate.md along with architecture-diagram.skipped before attempting generation, then only recreate architecture-diagram.md after successful validation.
